basis: Original source PNG opened and independently inventoried before opening candidate pixels or reading candidate spec/inventory.

inventory.observation: One unboxed shared graph, no subfigures, rows, columns, lattice, numbered ticks or quantitative scale. Horizontal axis points right; vertical axis points upward. They meet at the lower-left origin (roughly source pixel 92,390), with an O/zero-shaped glyph below-left. Vertical-axis symbol is sigma; horizontal-axis symbol is epsilon.

A single continuous thick solid curve starts at the origin, rises steeply and approximately straight to A, bends through B, levels near C, runs approximately horizontally from C to D, then rises gradually to the maximum E and falls sharply to terminal K. The curve is not drawn dashed. E is above all other labeled curve points and K is right of and below E. No extension beyond K is drawn.

Labels A, B, C, D, E, K occur locally along the curve in that left-to-right order. A is near source pixel 151,232; B near 174,201; C near 224,171; D near 281,170; E near 428,83; K near 480,134. These pixel positions identify the relationships, not measured stress or strain values. C and D share an approximately horizontal plateau; B is below C; A is below B. Labels are near their own point, not a remote legend.

Three thin solid horizontal guides start at the sigma axis. The lowest terminates at A (about y232), the middle at B (about y201), and the highest at E (about y83). Source left-side sigma labels have historical subscripts; the lowest denotes proportional stress, the middle elastic-limit stress, and the top maximum/ultimate stress in the approved lesson. The middle guide is not level with CD; the top guide is level with E, not K.

Thin solid vertical guides descend from A to the horizontal axis, E to an unlabeled horizontal-axis location, and K to the horizontal axis. The projection under A carries a q-like lower-case glyph (edition identity Q); the projection under K carries a p-like lower-case glyph (edition identity P). The E projection has no printed axis-value label. No vertical guide from B, C or D is visible.

All axes and all six visible guides are solid. The two axes have directional arrowheads. The three horizontal levels are ordered proportional < elastic < ultimate. The A/Q projection lies left of the E projection, which lies left of K/P. No units, numerical measurements, equidistant tick scheme, dashed unload curve or secondary true-stress curve is supplied.

interpretationBoundary: Pixel inventory supplies topology, line style, point/guide/label identity and qualitative ordering only. The complete approved bilingual text supplies engineering-stress/strain meaning, local stress-limit translation and material/safety caveats. No quantitative scale may be inferred from this schematic.
